name: Log Cabin Resort & Campground
evidence: operator resort map (uplogcabin.com/resortmap): Big Manistique shore strip is cabins (Edgewater, Cedar Lodge...), swim/boat beach and slips; RV sites 1-11/39-43 sit behind it. Satellite 46.2210,-85.7845: nearest RVs ~70-80 m back behind the cabin row and a shore treeline

name: Loomis Landing Campground and Marina
evidence: satellite 44.2336,-85.9095: point at Pine River mouth on Tippy backwaters is closed canopy, only the marina docks show; operator site (11 primitive sites, no site map) names no shoreline site. Canopy-blind and no per-site source, so default down

name: Potawatomie Campground & Recreation Area
evidence: operator Map 2023: Fox Lake frontage is the swim beach, fishing pier and boat launch (day-use); nearest sites E1/F1/G1/H1 are seasonal and inland of it. Satellite 42.0458,-85.0228: RVs ~40 m back behind a treed bank; Hog Creek along the M row is under canopy, not visible

name: Rivers Bend RV Resort & Campground
evidence: Pin was on the mobile-home rows south of the backwater; OSM 'River Bends Campground' and the RV loops are on the Menominee peninsula N. Satellite 45.8638,-88.0822 and 45.8643,-88.0795: RV pads with docks ~10-20 m from the river on the W and NE shores, plus canal sites; operator sells transient Riverfront W&E

name: Runkle Lake Park Campground
evidence: operator per-site map PDF (runklelakecamping.com/PDF/Campground-Map.pdf, scaled): closest site 44 is ~45 m from the lake with the loop road between; 52-55 sit behind the playground/beach day-use area. Satellite 46.1008,-88.3050: shore lane is boat launch/pier, treeline along the bank

name: Sunset Bay RV Resort & Campground
evidence: satellite 47.3800,-88.3973 (0.22 m/px): RV clearings in open shore spruce woods ~35-65 m from the Lake Superior waterline, only scattered trees and the campground's own lanes between, no road or day-use strip; operator 'private beachfront', camper photo shows lake through the trees

name: Tyler Creek Golf Course & Campground
evidence: operator map (campground-map_orig.jpg) is a hand-drawn overview; creek-side loop 1-27 is the primitive 'Trout Trail' sites, not stated RV (W&E sites are 'for RV's'). Satellite 42.8040,-85.3332: creek shows only at the bridge, under canopy elsewhere; nearest W&E RVs ~35-45 m back behind trees

name: Vagabond Resort
evidence: satellite 45.8690,-86.9483: resort loop and cabins sit east of County 513; Little Bay de Noc is ~300 m west across the road, houses and woods. The fishing dock is off-site; no RV site on or overlooking the bay
